name: Kiran Syntex Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Kiran Syntex Ltd manufactures and trades yarn.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KSL is the manufacturer and supplier of a wide 
assortment of Polyester Dyed Yarns available 
in different colours, these products are 
used in the textile and apparel industries. 
The company's range includes:
a) Polyester Mono Dyed Yarn
b) Polyester Filament Dyed Yarn
c) Polyester Air Textured Dyed Yarn
d) Polyester Slub Dyed Yarn
e) Polyester Space Dyed Yarn

cons: Stock is trading at 2.78 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -3.97% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 374 days.
